definition.description: Wayne ensures no misstep goes unpunished with an eagle's eye for weakness, granting all troops' attacks a X% Crit Rate.

entry.description: WIP attacks minxxx with attacker heroes Hector 2/3/2, Renee 3/3/3, and Wayne 2/2/2. Attacker fields 1700 infantry_t6 only; defender has no heroes and fields 300 infantry_t6 only. Game report result: attacker 1597 survivors, defender wiped.

XxWIPxX attacks Piddilyminxxx with Renee 3/3/3 and Wayne 3/3/3. Attacker fields 170 infantry_t6, 150 lancer_t6, and 190 marksman_t6; defender has no heroes and fields 888 infantry_t6. Game report result: attacker 427 survivors, defender wiped. Skill details report Renee triggers 20/1/1 with no listed kills, and Wayne triggers 30/20/19 with 23/-/33 listed kills.

WOS-111: Wayne mixed troops test. WIP 400/400/400 t6 attacking with Wayne (S1=2, S2=2, S3=3), minxxx 200/200/200 t6 defending no heroes. Tests all Wayne skills with mixed troop composition. S3 Fleet at level 3 = 15% crit chance for all troops. S2 Roundabout Hit fires every 2 attacks for marksmen vs lancers/marksmen. S1 Thunder Strike fires every 4 turns.

WOS-113: Wayne mixed troops test (second OCR capture). Same battle as entry 0 with minor OCR stat noise. Merged entries from multiple captures. Removed 1 corrupt entry (defender inf lethality OCR'd as 7.0).

WOS-229: Wayne (Marksman) + Reina (Lancer) combo. WIP attacking minxxx. Exercises multi-hero extra-attack stacking for WOS-227 formula audit. Active skills: Wayne S1=2 Thunder Strike (extra, op=1010, every 4 turns), Wayne S2=2 Roundabout Hit (extra, op=1011 vs lancers / op=1012 vs marksmen, every 2 attacks), Wayne S3=3 Fleet (15% crit chance, NOT extra), Reina S1=1 Assassin's Instinct (benefit_on=normal, +10% DamageUp, permanent), Reina S2=1 Swift Jive (4% dodge normal attacks). NOTE: Reina S3=0 — Shadow Blade (extra_attack=true, op=101) is INACTIVE. This combo therefore tests the normal_only + extra layer additive formula (Reina S1 + Wayne S1) but cannot discriminate multiplicative-vs-additive within the extra layer alone (requires Reina S3 unlocked). Run at least 8 battles due to Wayne S3 chance + Reina S2 dodge variance.

WOS-229: Wayne (Marksman) + Reina (Lancer) + Wu Ming (Infantry) full-class combo. WIP attacking minxxx. Extends wayne_reina_combo with Wu Ming adding base-layer DamageUp (S2=2 Crescent Uplift, op=101, all troops) and defensive normal+extra layer DefenseUp (S1=2 Shadow's Evasion, op=111, infantry-only). Active skills: Wayne S1=2 Thunder Strike (extra, op=1010), Wayne S2=2 Roundabout Hit (extra, op=1011/op=1012), Wayne S3=3 Fleet (15% crit, NOT extra), Reina S1=1 Assassin's Instinct (benefit_on=normal, +10%), Reina S2=1 Swift Jive (4% dodge), Wu Ming S1=2 Shadow's Evasion (DefenseUp benefit_on=normal+extra for infantry), Wu Ming S2=2 Crescent Uplift (+8% DamageUp base, all troops). NOTE: Reina S3=0 (Shadow Blade inactive), Wu Ming S3=0 (Elemental Resonance inactive). Wu Ming S1 exercises the defensive side of the normal/extra layer split on infantry. Run at least 8 battles due to Wayne S3 + Reina S2 variance.

WOS-38: Wayne S1 isolation test. WIP infantry-only 500 t6 attacking with Wayne (S1=2, S3=2), minxxx infantry-only 100 t6 defending no heroes. S2 cannot trigger (no marksmen). Tests Thunder Strike: extra attack every 4 turns at 40% damage (S1=2), plus Fleet: 10% crit rate (S3=2) for all troops. WIP expected to win with ~50% casualties. Note: S3 Fleet variance explains game result variance (247-256).

WOS-38: Wayne S2 isolation test. WIP marksman-only 400 t6 attacking with Wayne (S1=2, S2=2, S3=2), minxxx lancer-only 100 t6 defending no heroes. Tests Roundabout Hit: marksmen extra attack every 2 attacks vs lancers at 16% damage (S2=2). S1 also fires every 4 turns. S3 Fleet fires for marksmen at 10% chance. minxxx expected to win with ~50% casualties.
